description: R-CAT-1 fixture r-cat-1b-rel: tables Parent, Parent2, Child1 to Child6, ChildMC and Self, and Relations made with Database.CreateRelation and Relations.Append: R_Plain, R_Upd (dbRelationUpdateCascade), R_Del (dbRelationDeleteCascade), R_Both (both cascades), R_NoEnf (dbRelationDontEnforce) and R_Uni (dbRelationUnique) from Parent to Child1..Child6, the two-field R_Multi from Parent2 to ChildMC, and the self-referencing R_Self.
